en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 471 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Ibn Asbat from Hasan bin Jaham that he said:

“I asked His Eminence, Abul Hasan Musa bin Ja’far (a.s) regarding relief (Faraj). He replied: Don’t you know that waiting for the Faraj is Faraj? I asked: I don’t know anything, except what you have taught. He replied: Yes, waiting for the Faraj is (also) a kind of Faraj.”
